title: G1 ECDLP (powers-of-tau): W(n)=const (4,3) CM-STNFS over Q(zeta_15) behind a run gate: expected work 2^112.988503450037

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md, RANK-BRIDGE.md, THRESHOLD-REPAIR.md, ADAPTIVE.md) returns scalar s in 1..r-1 from T=[s]P0 (ignoring auxiliary powers A_2..A_n, valid for all 1 <= n < r, evaluated at scoring n = 2^20 = 1048576) via g=e(P0,Q0), z=e(T,Q0)=g^s with fresh-coin boot randomization with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1, H1', H-EA, H2, H3, H-R, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X and H5 (explicitly including de Bruijn local-density correction, closed-form 1D/2D 4-prime 62-bit NTT, fixed-instance H3 4-param hard-capped LA, H-R/H-X rank bridge with 1D-kernel Hankel+Horner verification, constructive 16D LLL rank-2 boot with RET_BOOT=0.50, half-scale NB-PGF T_k+psi^k union bound, full 1.0x survivor work, multi-factor ECM loops, and limb-scaled MR), at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64) x 10 x (2^111.0211186551+2^66) < 2^112.988503450037 batched affine G1 additions (C=2,000; 1 core unit = 10 G1 units): an expectation over the challenge and fresh coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every run. A run gate (u < K = 7213757831195772086, (K/2^64) x 0.997293 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.997293 (strict additive union bound) and costs at most 2^124.722652516288 units. Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
